largely stayed out of shale sale processes when it was prioritizing debt reduction and divestments, but since Meg O'Neill became CEO in April, the company reportedly has entered the data room on a small number of shale assets placed ​for sale by their owners.
The company reportedly has been targeting predominantly oil producing assets, with valuations in the $2B-$5B range, includes Devon Energy's

Entering a data room does not guarantee that BP
